answer.text: The standard minimum cold pressure for the rear N3R tyre on a low stress circuit is 1.3 bar (18.9 Psi).
For medium and high stress circuits, the minimum cold pressure for the rear N3R tyre is 1.2 bar (17.4 Psi).

The distinction between low stress and high/medium stress pressure values arises because the evidence lists specific circuits for the 1.3 bar value (e.g., Le Castellet, Macao) while the 1.2 bar value applies to tracks not listed in the Michelin Precos or those categorized as medium/high stress.

limitations.text: The evidence does not explicitly define a single universal 'standard' minimum cold pressure for the rear N3R tyre independent of circuit stress classification; instead, it provides conditional values based on track type.
